notes.labeling: trials are the sessions with non-zero token usage inside each probe HOME, ordered by start time (aborted 0-token starts are discarded)
notes.tokenMapping: inputTokens = input + cacheRead + cacheWrite; outputTokens = output; totalTokens unchanged from the session's own totalTokens
notes.provenance: each transcript's skill paths reference its condition's kit worktree (baseline transcripts cite pwk-probe-kit-baseline, candidate transcripts cite pwk-probe-kit-candidate)

observations: Baseline trials recorded no ADR (honest-empty) and zeroed in on delete+rebase; candidate-1 wrote ADR 0001-reject-zone-less-date from a real fork and shipped it before disposal.
The 'Scout: unavailable' recon note appears in baseline-1 and candidate-1 alike, so the slimmer text does not change that behavior.

All four runs so far self-caught an uncommitted feature-E2E file from the review packet's changed-file list (baseline-1 L70, candidate-1 L64) - a recurring commit-hygiene slip, not a kit-text difference.
